contracts: Each active handler creates a linked Type-0x5E base and Type-0x84 companion, stores the pair link at actor offset 0x3E, installs one selector-specific MovementVM stream on the base, and publishes the companion anchor through 0x00FFF094/0x00FFF096.
E0 uses base offset (0x00,+0x40); E1/E2, E3-E5, E8, E9, E6, and F9 use (-0x20,+0x40) for the companion placement contract.
Selector F9 additionally waits for gate byte 0x00FFF112 before creating the pair.
evidence: Exact paired-spawn bodies and INTERACTION_HANDLER_TABLE membership
Per-handler MovementVM stream literals and anchor-coordinate writes
limitations: No user-facing object identity is claimed for this paired-spawn family.
The complete unindexed 0x001B69A6 variant is intentionally not promoted by this active-dispatch finding.
conclusion: The active Type-0x5E/0x84 paired-spawn dispatch family now has stable creation identities with exact stream, link, anchor, offset, and gate contracts while preserving historical aliases.
